main.description: Escrow refund record. Per ADR-2605202900 Phase 2: record-only state transition (no on-chain tx — USDC was never moved). Phase 2b+ when @etzhayyim/sdk escrowRelease() ships: refundTxHash populated with the actual on-chain refund tx. Written by the canceller (typically buyer DID) on cancellation of the associated productionOrder.

forEscrowUri.description: AT URI of the escrowOpened record being refunded.

forProductionOrderUri.description: AT URI of the productionOrder that triggered this refund.

refundedByDid.description: DID of the actor refunding (typically buyer, sometimes arbiter).

refundTxHash.description: Phase 2: omitted (record-only). Phase 2b+: 0x-prefixed Base L2 tx hash from @etzhayyim/sdk escrowRelease().
